proposed_resolution: budget_stop becomes: 'The session reports error_max_budget_usd (exit 1, is_error true, no result key, errors naming the cap). Read the run record. It is completed with the whole result when the cap was passed after the workflow ended. It is killed, with error "Workflow aborted", result null and the running step left in progress, when the cap was passed during a step; stderr then says "Budget limit reached ...; stopping background agents." The caps are soft: in-flight calls are charged past the cap (2.7x a 2-cent cap here), so the session cap and refusal 8's total can be exceeded by one attempt's overshoot.
